name: LiveJournal

sources.title: LiveJournal account creation page — username/email/password, birthday, social login options

requirements: Email, username, password meeting complexity rules (8–30 ASCII chars, >=4 distinct symbols, at least 1 number + 1 special + 1 upper + 1 lower, not based on username/email)
Birthday field is required ('required by law'; only month/day displayed by default)
Social login alternatives: Google, VKontakte, Rambler, Mail.ru, Twitter/X, OpenID, Sber ID
preparation: Content plan — a real introductory post linking the product
workflow: Open livejournal.com/create and fill username/email/password/birthday/gender, or use a social login
Create the first post ('Create First Post' is offered post-signup) introducing/linking the product
Confirm the journal is public at <username>.livejournal.com
watchFor: LiveJournal is a legacy blogging community owned via Mail.ru ecosystem — social logins offered include Russian providers (VKontakte, Mail.ru, Sber ID); choose credentials you control
Password rules are unusually strict for 2026 — generate a compliant ASCII password
This is a blogging platform, not a directory — the listing is the journal itself and its public posts
Birthday year dropdown is required and public-by-default for month/day only
countsAsLive: The journal is publicly reachable at <username>.livejournal.com and the product post is visible to logged-out visitors
unknowns: Whether outbound post links are dofollow
Whether new accounts face post rate limits or link filtering
Whether journals get indexed in LiveJournal's public browse without community engagement
